shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,300p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"interface ToolDefinition|inputSchema\" src/types/ai.ts && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,80p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '35,170p' && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --name-only'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Compile tool schemas during registration" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
